title: Paginate the orders list endpoint
description: Customers with years of history were getting multi-MB responses from GET /api/orders. This adds `page` (1-based) and `page_size` query params and returns a paging envelope.

expected_issues.description: `page` is documented and clamped as 1-based, but the offset is `page * page_size`, so page 1 skips the first `page_size` orders and the newest orders are never returned. Should be `(page - 1) * page_size`.
